verdict.rationale: A probe confirms a live llms.txt at typesense.org/llms.txt (HTTP 200) that describes Typesense as built "for developers and AI agents." The docs also offer agent-friendly formats: a "Copy Markdown" option on API pages, guides served as .md (e.g. mcp-server.md), and a dedicated "Typesense for AI Agents" guide. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of how well agents consume these docs, no evidence of an llms-full.txt or a complete markdown docs index (the /docs/.md probe returned 404), and no evidence of the llms.txt contents beyond its header.
